analysis: Both changed files are test code. ResidentAdmissionGemma4Tests.swift changes one assertion at line 495, expecting Gemma rows to list supportedGenerationModes [.pipeline, .tensorParallel] instead of [.pipeline]. GemmaTensorParallelChecks.swift is a new placement check that builds layouts from retained headers and fixtures and compares them with golden layouts. It also checks the TP request allowance and the fastest-plan rule on synthetic Macs, links and devices. No production code, network path, key handling, attestation, authorization, encryption or cache storage is touched in the supplied evidence, so no regression is attributable to TB-002, TB-007, TB-011 or T-041. The tests read only local fixture paths derived from #filePath and golden URLs. They load no weights and do no I/O beyond fixtures. Residual integration questions, outside the supplied evidence: (1) the production change that enables Gemma tensor-parallel mode (the ClusterTensorParallelChoice.fastest rule, Gemma4TensorParallelPlan, Gemma4TensorParallelRequestBudget) is not in this batch. A reviewer should check that the TP collective payloads between ranks are sealed or keyed (the test mentions 'sealed frames' and 'keyed JACCL') and that the prompt-prefix capture budget does not widen the T-041 prefix-cache exposure. (2) The checks assert that reductions are keyed, but the real implementation is unverified here. The patch excerpt for GemmaTensorParallelChecks.swift was truncated, but the full patch text was visible in the unit and was examined.
